Definition: properly, a weakening; figuratively, alleviation, i.e. cure
BiblicalUsage: Kehah means a weakening, an alleviation, a cure. Nahum 3:19 says of Nineveh, there is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe some wounds have no healing because the sin behind them never repented, and Nineveh is the warning.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
